title: Subscription limits approaching
description: Monitors Azure subscription-level limits (resource counts, quotas) to prevent deployment failures from hitting limits.
example_prompt: "Check all subscriptions for resource quota usage. Show: (1) vCPU usage vs limit per family per region, (2) public IP count vs limit, (3) VNet count vs limit, (4) storage account count vs limit. Alert on any quota at > 80% utilization."
